thread.title: Dow Crosses 25,000 Again, but Don't Pop Open the Champagne Yet

author: Barron's
title: Dow Crosses 25,000 Again, but Don't Pop Open the Champagne Yet
text:
The major U.S. indexes opened slightly lower on Wednesday after two turbulent days, but soon spiked higher as the Dow crossed an important threshold.
Getty Images That's right, break out those Dow 25,000 hats again, but maybe leave the bubbly on ice for now.
By 10:20 a.m., the Dow was up 216 points, or 0.9% to 25,129, the S&P 500 rose 19 points to 2,714, and the Nasdaq rose 18 points to 7,134.
The CBOE Volatility Index (VIX) fell 25% to 22.43, a level that would be considered "normal" in a normal market environment. Of course, this week has been far from normal.
Given wide market fluctuations over the past two days, there's little reason to think the gains will hold at these levels. Energy, which has been particularly volatile lately, and cyclical consumer goods, were among the top performers. Tech, which has powered the market higher in the past year, was lagging. Apple ( AAPL ), for instance, slipped 0.5% in early trading.
